\parbox{432pt}{\scriptsize\raggedright \emph{contact model} and \emph{solver} are controlled vocabularies: \emph{soft} for a compliant or regularised contact, \emph{convex relaxation} for a convexified formulation, \emph{complementarity} for an LCP, \emph{hard NCP} for a nonlinear complementarity problem, \emph{impulse} for a velocity-level update, and \emph{rigid, model unstated} where the source describes collision geometry but names no contact law.
